ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (yellowish-white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and distal regions of both lobes are dominated by contiguous yellowish-white pigmentation. A high-contrast black border approximately 10-20 pixels wide follows the entire trailing edge. A dark vertical strip marks the peduncle-to-notch interface. Two distinct white patches interrupt the yellow field on the inner sections of both lobes near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 74 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of 48 pixels from the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations visible along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitudes of individual peaks range from 3 to 8 pixels against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, exhibiting localized upward concavity at the extreme outer edges of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (4-6 pixels in diameter) detected on the mid-left and lower-central yellow pigment fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the outer portion of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the far left distal tip; irregular indentation and darker scarring on the upper right margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dominant yellowish-tan surface hue across the majority of the high-intensity areas, sharply contrasted by localized pure white patches.
